dialogues.en:
<$voicel(3,7)><$motion(3,805)><$comeff(3,14)>So, um, you know how I was talking about the place where
I lived before? There was a really big, really pretty forest
near there, <$voicel(3,6)><$motion(3,807)>and that area was always SUPER humid!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(3,7)><$motion(3,805)><$comeff(3,14)>Então, sabe como eu estava a falar sobre o lugar onde...
Havia uma floresta muito grande e muito bonita.
perto dali, <$voicel(3,6)><$motion(3,807)>e aquela área era sempre SUPER úmida!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,806)><$facial(3,4)>So I was hoping you could water the dried-up trees around
here and make ’em all healthy again!
<$voicel(3,10)><$comeff(3,21)><$motion(3,801)><$facial(3,5)>I bet that’d make the place even more humid!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,806)><$facial(3,4)>Esperava que pudesses regar as árvores secas à volta.
aqui e torná-los todos saudáveis novamente!
<$voicel(3,10)><$comeff(3,21)><$motion(3,801)><$facial(3,5)>Aposto que isso tornaria o lugar ainda mais úmido!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(3,7)><$motionoff(3,804)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,10)>If you see any dried-up trees, could you please
water them?
<$voicel(3,10)><$motion(3,803)><$facial(3,1)><$comeff(3,20)>Oh, wait a second! I just remembered something!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(3,7)><$motionoff(3,804)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,10)>Se vires alguma árvore seca, pode por favor?
- Regar-lhes?
<$voicel(3,10)><$motion(3,803)><$facial(3,1)><$comeff(3,20)>Acabei de me lembrar de uma coisa!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(3,7)>There were lots and lots of dried-up trees on the beach
over that way!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(3,7)>Havia muitas árvores secas na praia.
Por ali!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,14)>Oooh, the trees around here look so much healthier now!
Did YOU do that? <$voicel(3,10)><$emotion(3,6)>Thank you!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,14)>As árvores por aqui parecem muito mais saudáveis agora!
Fizeste isso? <$voicel(3,10)><$emotion(3,6)>Obrigado!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(3,5)><$motion(3,666)>By the way, didja know that you can also plant new trees
from seeds? <$voicel(3,8)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,9)>Here—try it out!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(3,5)><$motion(3,666)>A propósito, didja sabia que você também pode plantar novas árvores
De sementes? <$voicel(3,8)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,9)>Aqui, experimenta!

dialogues.en: You got some <$cdef(27)><fqty(2)><$ifull(1822)></color>!
dialogues.pt_br: Tu tem algum <$cdef(27)><fqty(2)><$ifull(1822)></color>!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(3,5)><$motion(3,805)><$comeff(3,14)>The seeds can really take a long time to grow after you
plant them, though.
<$voicel(3,7)><$motion(3,801)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,10)>But I can help—um, just a little—when you’re growing trees
’n’ flowers ’n’ stuff!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(3,5)><$motion(3,805)><$comeff(3,14)>As sementes podem realmente levar muito tempo para crescer depois de você
Mas plantem-nos.
<$voicel(3,7)><$motion(3,801)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,10)>Mas eu posso ajudar - um, apenas um pouco - quando você está crescendo árvores
'n’ coisas de flores 'n'!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>I see a lot more healthy trees around here than before.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Vejo muito mais árvores saudáveis por aqui do que antes.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Thanks to them, the air feels a bit more humid too!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Graças a eles, o ar parece um pouco mais úmido também!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>It seems that having more healthy flowers around increases
the humidity as well!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Parece que ter flores mais saudáveis ao redor aumenta
A humidade também!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,14)>Growing various other plants might be a good idea too.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,14)>Cultivar várias outras plantas pode ser uma boa idéia também.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(3,9)><$motion(3,803)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,21)>If there are any plants you want to grow faster, then come
and get me!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(3,9)><$motion(3,803)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,21)>Se houver alguma planta que você quer crescer mais rápido, então venha
E apanha-me!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,8)>Hey, <$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,3)><$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>! I’ve got an idea!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,8)>Olá. <$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,3)><$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>Eu tenho uma idéia!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,8)>I bet if there was a spot around here with some tall grass
near water, it’d be nice and <$cdef(27)>humid—just the way I like it!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,8)>Aposto que se houvesse um lugar por aqui com alguma erva alta
perto da água, seria bom e <$cdef(27)>húmido- tal como eu gosto!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,6)>I was thinking... Maybe you could make an area like that?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,6)>Estava a pensar... talvez pudesses fazer uma área dessas?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,8)>Do you think you could grow some grass near the water
around here? I bet it’d be nice and <$cdef(27)>humid!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,8)>Achas que pode plantar erva perto da água?
por aqui? Eu aposto que seria bom e <$cdef(27)>húmido!

<$cdef(27)>!
